name: @core/3d
summary: 3D made simple: product spins, exploded views, depth travelling, hero objects.
guide:
3D without a 3D tool. Scenes: three:product-spin {image, device: phone|tablet|card|box, title, subtitle, side, turn}, three:exploded {items:[{label,color}], title, split (seconds), gap}, three:depth-cards {items:[{image|color}], title, spacing}, three:hero-object {title, shape, material, color, lights}.
The raw layer {"type":"three"} takes objects (shape box|roundedBox|sphere|cylinder|cone|torus|knot|plane|capsule|ring|card|device|image|icosahedron|octahedron|group, size, position, rotation in degrees, scale, material glass|metal|matte|plastic|emissive|toon|wire or {type,color,metalness,roughness,…}, image "asset:<id>" on cards/devices (transparent PNG/WebP are detected: no slab or black behind, shadow shaped like the drawing; "alpha":true|false|"auto", "alphaTest" 0.5; shape "image" = free cut-out sized to the picture), keys {position|rotation|scale|opacity: [[s, value, "ease"]]}, spin [deg/s], float, explode, children),
lights ("studio"|"soft"|"dramatic"|"neon" or a list), camera {fov, position, target, keys, orbit {speed,radius,height}, dolly {from,to}, shake}, stack {items, shape, size, step, explode} to build piles from data, explode {at,d,amount}, ground {opacity,y}, fog, environment.
Rendering uses WebGL (render.gl in config: "angle" with a GPU, "swangle" on servers).
